newsitem.title: POLAND: ZEW DOWN 5.2 PCT AFTER FLOOD DAMAGE.
newsitem.headline: ZEW DOWN 5.2 PCT AFTER FLOOD DAMAGE.

text.p: Polish electrode maker ZEW SA fell 5.2 percent in moderate trade to 29 zlotys on Monday, resuming trade after a month-long suspension due to flooding.
Last month ZEW, based in the badly hit town of Raciborz, said it had incurred losses exceeding 50 million zlotys due to the flooding but would receive full insurance compensation.
Analysts said the buoyant overall market may have prevented a deeper ZEW fall on Monday but that the firm's stronger selling after price-fixing that day signalled another fall on Tuesday.
